「接続・転送」で右パネルを開きます。「閉じる」で編集画面全体を使えます。「保存」: Open Connect and transfer to show the right panel. Close it to use the full editor. Save downloads an editable project file. Save at the end of each lesson as well as transferring to the hub.
「教員・指導者用」→「Pythonを見る」で左にブロック、右にPythonを表示: Choose For teachers, then View Python to show blocks on the left and Python on the right. Drag the divider, or focus it with Tab and use the arrow keys to resize. Go to start code scrolls to the first start or event; it does not run the program. The read-only view updates after block changes, undo, or loading a project. Errors clear old code and show the reason. Close or Esc returns to the full editor. The connection panel and Python panel alternate, while the hub stays connected.
「接続・転送」を開いて接続すると、ポートA〜Fの機器と値を約0.5秒ごとに更新し: Connect using the connection panel to see devices and readings for ports A to F, updated about every 0.5 seconds. Color sensors show the color name, color number, and reflected light. Older notifications without reflected light are marked unavailable. Pause updates stops readings; Read and refresh resumes them. After 3 seconds without updates, or a read error, readings are marked as previous values. Disconnecting clears them. Reading sensors does not transfer a test program or overwrite a hub slot.
速さは−100〜100％です。100％を1050度/秒に換算します。「動き」には: Speed ranges from -100% to 100%; 100% corresponds to 1050 degrees per second. Movement has separate forward, backward, spin, and pivot blocks. Place the left/right drive motor setup immediately after Start and match your wiring. Subsequent movements, including those inside My Blocks, use this shared setup. Running another setup block stops the previous pair before switching; setup itself does not turn motors. Single and paired motor blocks retain their own port settings. Set the actual wheel diameter for distance moves and wheel track for turns.
上部のボタンで名前と引数を設定します。定義ブロックの中へ命令を入れ、「マイブロッ: Use Make a My Block to set a name and inputs. Add instructions inside its definition, then call it from My Blocks. Get inputs from the Inputs category and use them inside the definition. No return value groups instructions. Return numbers supports up to 8 named results, each with an expression. A round call goes in a number input and selects a result; it runs the definition on each call. Use a call that stores results in variables to receive all results in one call. Return and exit ends the definition early. Delete calls before changing return types or counts, then recreate them. Unconnected blocks and unused definitions are not transferred.
加速時間は最低速度から指定最高速度まで、減速時間は最高速度から最低速度までの速度: Acceleration time is the time for the speed command to rise from the minimum to the maximum; deceleration time is the reverse. For a minimum of 8%, maximum of 50%, and deceleration of 0.1 seconds, the command falls from 50% to 8% in about 0.1 seconds. Actual motor speed is not guaranteed to follow in that time. Choose trapezoidal or S-curve ramps; 0 seconds changes immediately. Angle and distance moves account for response lag in the start position without stretching the ramp time. Short moves may shorten the ramp and never reach maximum speed.
最低速度は初期8％です。モーター末尾の「加減速の最低速度を○％にする」で共通設定: The default minimum speed is 8%. Set it with the minimum ramp speed block at the end of Motors. It also applies to timed moves and never exceeds the chosen maximum speed. Continuous rotation and absolute-position moves are excluded. If an angle move barely turns for about 0.4 seconds near its endpoint, it stops and reports an error.
秒指定とは別の「距離の比率で加減速」を使います。100cm・加速区間10％・減速: Use distance-based ramping separately from timed ramps. For a 100 cm move with 10% acceleration and 10% deceleration, the first 10 cm ramps up, the last 10 cm ramps down, and the middle 80 cm uses maximum speed. Each percentage is 0 to 100 and their sum must not exceed 100. The most recently executed ramp setup is used. Switch to timed ramps for timed moves. The distance-based example uses 10% for each ramp. Percentages describe commanded sections based on shaft rotation, not guaranteed floor distance or actual speed tracking.
Python表示は最初に「作ったプログラム」を表示し、「内部処理」で共通処理へ切: Python first shows Your program; Runtime shows shared support code. Generated comments use the interface language. My Block input names are preserved when valid in Python; symbols, reserved words, and duplicates receive safe alternatives. Save Python (2 files) downloads program.py and sbl_runtime.py with a README in a ZIP file. Transfer combines them into one shared namespace. program.py does not run alone. You can also save the combined transfer file.
音・制御・演算・データ・記録・変数・マイブロック・引数の基本ブロックと並びを共通: Basic blocks and ordering for sound, control, operators, data, recording, variables, My Blocks, and inputs are shared with EBL and EBL-RT. Sound supports 250 to 10000 Hz and 1 to 30000 milliseconds; volume is a fixed input from 0 to 100. Remainder, random, minimum, maximum, rounding, and clamping have separate blocks. Strings allow up to 120 UTF-8 bytes and support Japanese character counts. Positions start at 1; positions beyond the text return an empty string. Numeric variables start at 0, text variables as empty strings, and numeric lists empty. Input-only names are excluded from normal variables. PID reuses the previous value for recalculations in the same millisecond and restarts from its P term after a pause over 60 seconds.
「CSVログ」の開始・値記録・終了はEBLと同じ表現です。SBLは1000行・3: CSV log start, record, and finish use the same wording as EBL. SBL buffers up to 1000 rows or 32 KiB in memory, then saves with the finish block after motors stop. Storage, column names, and limits differ from EBL. Automatic synchronization logging is SPIKE-specific. Existing SBL projects with old blocks can load, but EBL and EBL-RT project files cannot be imported directly. Negative remainders follow EBL (-5 modulo 3 is 1). EBL-RT still differs in sign behavior; see the manual.
記録は最大1000行・32KiBをメモリに蓄えます。電源を切る前に、モーターを停: Recording buffers up to 1000 rows or 32 KiB in memory. Stop motors and finish recording to save CSV before powering off. Motor synchronization logging records angle difference, actual speed, speed command, and ramp phase at matching timestamps. Actual speed is angle change divided by actual sample interval; the first value is blank. Synchronization examples compare enabled and disabled correction. Correction smooths the lead over about 200 ms, ignores differences up to 4 degrees, and slows only the leading motor by up to 3%. Beyond 4 degrees, the rate is 0.15% per degree; command change is limited to 31.5 degrees/second per second. Speed stays above the 8% minimum and ramps are not stretched. The 80%, 100 cm, 20% example uses S-curves, an 8% minimum, enabled synchronization, and 100 ms logging. Match ports to your robot and compare identical conditions. This does not correct wheel slip, heading, or large mechanical differences. Reduced wobble on real hardware has not been verified.
モーターグループはL・Mを分けず、1個の操作と専用同期に整理しました。「同期する: The Motors category groups single-motor controls and dedicated paired synchronization without separate L/M categories. Set the synchronized motors and their directions first, then use continuous, angle, rotation, time, and stop blocks. Negative speed reverses both configured directions. Drive motor setup is separate. Paired correction is always active, and ramps apply to finite moves. Individually controlling one motor during continuous synchronization stops the other. Old two-motor and L/M-specific blocks no longer appear in the palette but still load from saved projects. Try the two synchronized motors example. Hardware behavior remains unverified.
SPIKE固有の絶対角度は0〜360度（360度は0度）、速さ1〜100％、最短: SPIKE absolute position uses 0 to 360 degrees (360 equals 0), speed from 1% to 100%, and shortest, clockwise, or counterclockwise paths. It uses standard hub position control, not the shared ramp or synchronization correction.
対象なし・測定範囲外では、専用の距離条件は「＞・≧・≠」を真、「＜・≦・＝」を偽: When no target is detected or distance is out of range, dedicated distance comparisons treat greater-than, greater-or-equal, and not-equal as true; less-than, less-or-equal, and equal are false. A distance greater than 15 cm condition therefore also runs with no target. Use the valid-reading block to check whether a measurement is available. Disconnected-device errors are still reported.
命令ごとの固定10ミリ秒待ちを廃止しました。「0.02秒待つ」は全体の周期保証で: There is no fixed 10 ms delay after every instruction. A 0.02-second wait does not guarantee the total loop period; calculations and hub APIs take additional time. Put PID recording inside the loop after motor commands and supply the calculated reflected light, PID output, and left/right speeds. Five rows at each timestamp also record an estimate of the control interval. Start with a 3-second run and 100 ms logging; for 120 seconds, start with 1000 ms logging. Match recording and retrieval names. Shorter loops require checking previously saved gains on real hardware again.
SPIKEにはEV3のようなディスプレイがないため、画像ブロックは一覧から外して: SPIKE does not have an EV3-style screen, so image blocks are hidden from the palette. Display supports the 5 x 5 lights, text, numbers, and abacus-style display. SBL is intended to grow with learning and future SPIKE-RT integration. SPIKE-RT generation and transfer are future plans; the current app runs on standard Hub OS.
EV3 Block Labと同じ流れで、ブロックをつなぎ、本体に保存して試します: Connect blocks, save to the hub, and try your program, following the same workflow as EV3 Block Lab. This app targets standard Hub OS compatible with SPIKE App 3.
